name: Legend of Gaia: Rebirth
description:
About This Game

In a war between gods, she lost everyone.

Driven by hatred, she joined the Order of the Templar Knights and set foot upon the Eternal Continent in search of the scattered fragments of the Relic of Rebirth.

The Legend of Gaia: Rebirth is a 2D side-scrolling action-adventure game. Explore secret-filled regions, confront formidable enemies, and uncover a truth buried deep within history through combos, parries, perfect dodges, and customizable Magic Stone builds.

This is the mission placed upon her, and the ending she once believed awaited her.

Yet every fragment carries a memory she cannot understand.

With every step forward, it feels as though someone has already laid out the path before her.

And she does not yet know where that path will lead.

Enter the Eternal Continent

When the gods descended, magic became the fifth fundamental force of the universe.

From that moment on, gods, dragons, beasts, and humans coexisted on this planet, clashing over faith, power, and survival.

A thousand years of war reshaped the land and caused the histories of old to fade from memory.

Now, the divine order, the forces of Gaia, and the forces of sin stand opposed. Lillia, a Templar Knight who lost her family, begins her journey amid a conflict that has endured for a millennium.

Is she seeking the Relic of Rebirth, or the truth buried beneath history itself?

Features

Explore Diverse Regions

Cross mist-shrouded forests, descend into dark underground caverns, explore haunted temples, climb treacherous mountains, and finally enter an ancient tower hidden at the end of the journey.

Discover hidden paths, treasures, and secrets scattered throughout distinct environments.

Fluid Combo Combat

Chain light attacks, heavy attacks, and skills freely. Master parries and perfect dodges to control the rhythm of battle and create your own combos.

Poise and Guard Break System

Relentlessly pressure enemies to deplete their poise. When their defenses break, seize the opening and deliver a devastating blow.

Magic Stone Equipment System

Collect, dismantle, and enhance different Magic Stones. Combine abilities to match your combat style and build your own approach to battle.
short_desc: Legend of Gaia: Rebirth is a 2D side-scrolling action-adventure. Journey across the Eternal Continent, where the Theocracy, Gaia faction, and forces of Sin struggle for power. Explore dangerous regions, battle powerful enemies, and collect the scattered fragments of the Rebirth Relic.
